files.description: Exam scores (60 rows, one per student): student (full name, unique, many with accented letters), then math, art and music (scores 35-100, whole numbers; about 9% of these score cells are empty, and one student has no score at all).

task_text: Turn the score table into a long list with one row per student and subject that has a score; cells without a score are left out. `result` should be a table with the columns student, subject and score.
intended_computation: Reshape the wide table (student; math, art, music) to long form and drop the empty cells: 164 rows (180 cells minus 16 empty), columns student, subject (one of math, art, music) and score.

acceptable_variants.notes: row order is free; score may be whole numbers or decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: stack() dropped the empty cells on 2.x as the task asks; on 3.x it keeps them, adding 16 rows without a score.
